summary: Annovis Bio filed an 8-K on 2026-11-05 disclosing an Underwriting Agreement with Canaccord Genuity LLC for a public offering of 19,000,000 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for up to 2,000,000 shares, accompanied by warrants for up to 21,000,000 shares. Combined price is $1.00 per share plus warrant ($0.9999 per pre-funded unit); gross proceeds expected near $21.0 million before discounts and expenses. Accompanying warrants strike $1.00, expire five years out; 4.99%/9.99% beneficial-ownership blockers apply, up to 19.99% with notice. This is a routine shelf-style capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
